export_evidence: No export record found. The only customs dataset retrieved is an IMPORT dataset: ImportKey page 'WISHTEL PRIVATE LIMITED- Import Customs Data Records' shows 'Total Shipments 926 Records detected' with every visible row having Wishtel as BUYER and a foreign supplier as shipper, e.g. '2026-02-13 | MINGFANG TECHNOLOGY (HONGKONG)CO.LT | WISHTEL PRIVATE LIMITED | SPARE FOR TABLETS PC FLIP COVER ... | HONG KONG, CHINA | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | 85177990 | 7513462'. Destination is India in all rows; no outbound shipment, no foreign buyer, no export B-L number was seen. Source counter: ImportKey reported 926 total records; 5 shipment rows were actually rendered on the free view (plus 5 supplier rows and 5 port rows). Export-side sources could not be read: volza.com/p/wishtel/export/ returned HTTP 403, eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, trademo.com returned HTTP 403, and DuckDuckGo web_search was unavailable (connection refused) for the whole session, so absence of export evidence is based on the one readable dataset plus failed lookups, not on an exhaustive export-database check.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved. Attempted and blocked: zaubacorp.com (HTTP 403), thecompanycheck.com (HTTP 403), wishtel.com (HTTP 500). No domestic supply record was seen, but this is a retrieval failure rather than a negative finding, so status is 'unknown' and not 'none_found'.
